description: Translate books, documents, AiNiee projects, Unity localization caches, or flat MTool JSON dictionaries end to end on the coding agent itself without the AiNiee app. Use for requests such as "用 agent 翻译这本书", "把 epub 翻译了", "翻译 Unity CSV/cache", "把这个 MTool JSON 翻译了", or "AiNiee-style translation" that need a locked glossary, resumable batches or bounded subagent groups, terminology consistency, source-aware QA, validated cache writeback, and export. For MTool, preserve the left JSON key as immutable source text and write only the right value as translation.
